docs.note: Two chunks' factual claims restate the same statistic, one with more numeric detail (superset).

factual_claims.claim: A 2026 industry survey found that 57 percent of firms had adopted at least one generative AI tool.
A 2026 industry survey found that 57 percent of firms had adopted at least one generative AI tool, up from 35 percent the prior year.

docs.note: Two factual claims differ only in which group's percentage they report -- cosine-alone would wrongly fold these (t/4472 finding); the numeric guard must keep them separate.

factual_claims.claim: Among surveyed adults in the Asian demographic group, 57 percent reported regular AI tool usage.
Among surveyed adults in the Hispanic demographic group, 36 percent reported regular AI tool usage.
